# Business Booster

> Growth agency in Kalubowila, Colombo, Sri Lanka. One in-house team makes films, posts and photographs, builds websites, runs SEO, AEO and GEO, runs paid ads and builds business systems for 20+ active clients. The way to start is WhatsApp on +94 76 741 2531.

## Services
- [Social media](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/production/): Films, posts and photographs made to bring a customer one step closer, not to fill a calendar.
- [Websites](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/websites/): Designed and built by our own team, fast on a cheap phone on mobile data, with search built in from the first day.
- [SEO](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/seo/): SEO in plain words: when someone in Sri Lanka types what you sell, your page is the one they land on.
- [AEO](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/aeo/): AEO: writing and structuring pages so that Google's answer box, voice assistants and AI answers pull their answer from you.
- [GEO](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/geo/): GEO: when someone asks an AI assistant for a good hotel in Wadduwa or a reliable garage in Nugegoda, your name is in the answer.
- [Ads](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/ads/): Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns run by the same team that makes the content, with tracking set up before the first rupee is spent and a read of the numbers every week.
- [Systems store](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/systems/): nine business systems, each with its true status.

- [Rank yourself](https://businessboosterlk.github.io/rank/): a website speed scan, an SEO scan and three short quizzes; each quiz hands its result to WhatsApp.
